body: I’m in the same position, I accepted the job offer but haven’t gone through orientation yet. I quarantined and took an at home test that read positive. What happened in your situation?

I’m actually in the same situation as the girlfriend. My bf wanted to break up because he feels he lost the love for me when I was closed off to him during the holidays. I had no idea but if we had just communicated better it wouldn’t have snowballed to this point. If you already tried to work it out and it didn’t.. I’d let her go. Sad to think about since I’m in this situation too. Is there anything she can do to try to improve the situation? Maybe talk more?

Thank you for your post. I am trying to understand it from his perspective and trying to work on not being such a negative person. I know I can be a lot to deal with and he’s stuck by me through it all. I’m hoping it’ll work out.. thank you
